headline_en: Hot US jobs data lifts Fed hike odds, TSLA (DOWNTREND) drops 5.92% as yields spike
executive_bullets_en: Strong August jobs report pushed 2-year yields higher and priced in at least one 25bp Fed hike by year-end, with Wall Street closing lower Friday
MU (UPTREND) surged 6.10% on AI-driven HBM demand while PLTR (ACCUMULATION) holds near 52-week high despite pullback
US weighing 100% tariffs on Korean memory chips adds supply risk to semis already under rate pressure
executive_bullets_ko: 8월 고용 보고서로 2년물 금리 상승, Fed 25bp 인상 확률 높아지며 금요일 증시 하락
MU (UPTREND) AI HBM 수요로 6.10% 급등, PLTR (ACCUMULATION) 52주 고점 근처에서 눌림 유지
미국이 한국 메모리 칩에 100% 관세 검토 중, 반도체 공급 리스크 추가

market_mood.explanation_en: The 77.8 regime score is like a yellow traffic light at an intersection: the road ahead looks mostly clear but you still tap the brakes. It means the market environment supports selective buying but warns against chasing everything without checking individual stock structures first.

big_picture.summary_en: Hot US jobs data shifted Fed expectations sharply higher within 48 hours, driving equity selling and Treasury yield spike. Reports indicate Washington is weighing 100% tariffs on Samsung and SK Hynix memory products while Taiwan considers tighter AI chip export rules.

big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 14.53, a low level that signals calm rather than fear or overconfidence in the options market.
big_picture.vix_note_ko: VIX가 14.53에 머물러 있습니다. 이는 시장이 두려워하거나 과도하게 자신만만해하지 않는, 비교적 차분한 상태라는 의미입니다.
big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield at 4.78% is high enough to pressure growth stocks by raising discount rates on future earnings.

big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 99.16, a modest rise that can weigh on tech and global earnings translation for US multinationals.

big_picture.btc_note_en: Bitcoin is at $79,914.50, up 0.11% today and 3.24% over five days. This mild upside suggests risk appetite remains tentatively positive.
